title: CastBot Update
subtitle: Multi-Section Maps — Add a Second Map, Page Between Them, Teleport Players Across

cards.title: Map Sections
desc: Your Safari is no longer one map. Add Section takes a brand
new image, builds its channels and fog in its own category,
and joins it to your season mid-game — the existing map is
never touched. Players cross only where you place a Teleport.

cards.title: Page Through Your Maps
desc: Map Explorer grows PREV / NEXT arrows that flip between
section images. Update Map, Delete and Blacklist all act on
the section you are looking at — replace one area's art or
delete a finished area without touching the rest.

cards.title: Teleports Land Properly
desc: A teleported player now gets the same arrival card a walking
player gets — posted in the destination channel with a
Navigate button — and their stale compass at the old cell is
cleaned up. Silent navigate mode still suppresses it.

cards.title: Wide Maps Actually Work
desc: Maps wider than 26 columns always generated fine — then
movement quietly broke past column Z. Coordinates like AA5
now work everywhere: compass moves, blacklists, overlays,
teleports. A 30-column idol hunt is a real option now.

cards.title: Actions Stay Where You Put Them
desc: Opening an existing action from another location's menu used
to silently attach it to that location — half-wired, so the
button never even appeared. Now looking is just looking. Add
locations on purpose in Action Editor > Locations.

underHood: Movement seals at every section edge
One arrival card for walk, teleport & admin moves
